integrationNotes: Freelance Writing & Copywriting is a core ₦0 skill-based hustle. Primary platforms for Nigerians: Fiverr, Upwork, direct WhatsApp/LinkedIn outreach to local businesses, Contently-style, and Nigerian content agencies. Dollar clients via Payoneer/Grey/Wise. Start with portfolio samples (even self-written). High demand niches: SEO blog posts, product descriptions, email sequences, social captions, sales pages. Realistic beginner rates ₦5k–₦25k per article locally; $15–$80+ for international once reviews exist.
